settings.caption: WHO WE ARE
settings.heading: WE’RE A CREW THAT’S DEDICATED AND PASSIONATE ABOUT FILM PHOTOGRAPHY
settings.text: We offer a wide variety of analog photography-focused services, with film development, scanning, camera sales, and archiving being at the core of our offerings.

Coastal Film Lab started as a passion project of founder Stephen Zane in 2016. With the pandemic, there was a huge influx of interest in film photography that allowed him to expand to a retail photography store in mid 2021. In the year since, we have grown to a crew of six, offering a wide variety of analog photography focused services, with film developing, scanning, and camera sales and service being at the core of our offerings.

We’re located at 1704 N Nebraska Ave Tampa, Florida 33602 between Ybor city and the Channel district.

 We are here to help, regardless of if you just started, are getting back into film, or never stopped! 

If you’re in need of film or *gasp* digital photography, www.stephenzane.com is how to reach us for that.
